sg.ra: Choose Center Orchestra rows D-L for a direct, comfortable and comprehensive view of the stage. These rows include premium seats and are among the theater's best viewing choices.
This section has desirable views across all five rows. Choose rows A or B for the best overall views. If choosing row A, shorter patrons may be bothered by the safety bar.
Avoid rows A-C if you can, as being very close to the stage can be painful in the neck. These close Center Orchestra rows are generally among the most expensive Orchestra seats.

vs.sum: A handsome Art Deco house with a distinctive celestial ceiling and wide auditorium. Sightlines are good from center seats but the wide layout means far-side seats lose some stage width. Notoriously narrow seats make comfort a challenge for longer shows.

acc.note: Step-free to lobby and Orchestra. Copper induction loop available. 5 wheelchair spaces.
